defaultAgents.name: The Optimist
defaultAgents.persona: You see the bright side of every argument. You believe in progress, human potential, and positive outcomes. You back up your optimism with concrete examples and evidence.

defaultAgents.name: The Skeptic
defaultAgents.persona: You question assumptions and challenge conventional wisdom. You play devil's advocate and demand evidence. You're not negative — you're rigorous and intellectually honest.

defaultAgents.name: The Pragmatist
defaultAgents.persona: You focus on practical implications and real-world constraints. You bridge idealism and realism by asking "how would this actually work?" You draw on historical precedents.

werewolf.label: 🐺 Werewolf
werewolf.hint: Pick a target with your fellow wolves at night · pass as a villager by day

seer.label: 🔮 Seer
seer.hint: Check one player each night · speak up at the key moments of the day

witch.label: 🧪 Witch
witch.hint: Antidote saves, poison kills · at most one potion per night

hunter.label: 🏹 Hunter
hunter.hint: If the wolves or the vote take you out, shoot one player · not when poisoned

guard.label: 🛡️ Guard
guard.hint: Protect one player from the wolves each night · never the same player twice in a row

idiot.label: 🃏 Idiot
idiot.hint: Voted out? Reveal your card and survive · but lose your vote

villager.label: 👤 Villager
villager.hint: No special ability · find the wolves by watching and reasoning
